LanguageData.JLS_Parts_Desc: Switch off any part you don't want. Its buildings and research are removed from the game.
LanguageData.JLS_Part_Beamwire_Desc: Emitters, receivers, mirrors, splitters, prisms, relays, safety shutters, capacitors and beam windows. Without it, the lasers run on their power grid alone.
LanguageData.JLS_Part_MiningLaser_Desc: A three-barrelled turret that cuts rock marked for mining, for full yield.
LanguageData.JLS_Part_LaserCannon_Desc: A twin-barrelled defence turret that burns hostiles. The laser control console stays while either laser is on.
LanguageData.JLS_Parts_Restart: Restart RimWorld for this to take effect. Buildings of a part you switch off disappear from existing saves.
LanguageData.JLS_ArtStyle: Art style for every building in the mod
